paragraphs.text: Grammar Analysis
Language bricks

texts: Ongoing actions are stated through the present progressive.  Check out the following examples.
I am doing my homework now.
Are you doing your homework now?
I am not doing my homework now.
They are talking on the phone right now.
Are they talking on the phone right now?
They are not talking on the phone right now.
He is practicing for the soccer finale these days.
Is he practicing for the soccer finale these days?
He is not practicing for the soccer finale these days.
Currently, They are rebuilding the house.
Are they currently rebuilding the house?
No, they are not currently rebuilding the house.
Verb To Be acts as an auxiliary.
-Ing form is added to end of the main verbs.

paragraphs.text: Language Use
Functional English

texts: He is taking a shower now. / We are having English class at the moment.
Actions happening for a certain time period.
We are rehearsing for the recital these days. / For now, I am doing work from home.
Jake is always eating burgers. / They are always playing soccer.
When we use the present progressive we can take into account some functions.
Time phrases may vary a little depending on the function we want to express.
There is a fourth function related to expressing future.

Vacations Dear Annie, how are you? I am writing these lines from the hotel room. I am having a good time these days because Cancun is so beautiful. We are getting ready now because we are going on a tour in some minutes. My brother is enjoying every moment and my dad is making all he can to make us happy. Right now, we are also having breakfast. How are your vacations going? Please write. Love, Laurie.
